name: Sati: Meditate & Study
subtitle: Meditate, study, scroll less
promotional_text: Free from the Buddhist Society of Australia. Meditate, study with focus and meet your phone with a pause, and watch Padma the lotus bloom.
description:
Less scrolling. More stillness.

Sati (Pali for mindfulness) is a free practice companion from the Buddhist Society of Australia, a registered charity. Meet Padma, a little lotus who blooms when you meditate, study with focus and meet your phone with a pause instead of a reflex, and who wilts when the scroll takes over.

TEND YOUR LOTUS
• A daily clarity score brings Padma and her world to life, from a blooming lotus pond to a dry, grey field
• Track screen time, pickups and your top distractions alongside your practice
• A simple daily checklist: sit, study, read, recite the Refuges, one act of kindness

SIT
• Guided breath meditation (Anapanasati), loving-kindness (Metta), body scan or silent sitting
• A synthesised singing bowl, interval bells and an open-ended sit
• Save sessions to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes

GUARD YOUR ATTENTION
• Mindful doorways: three slow breaths before a distracting app, then choose to stay present or open it with a clear intention
• Guards such as Study Hall, Morning Sit and Night Rest make the doorway stricter at the times you choose

STUDY WITH RIGHT EFFORT
• A focus timer (25/5, 50/10 or 90/15) that gently counts each time your mind wanders off
• A Dharma library: the Three Refuges, Four Noble Truths, Eightfold Path, Five Precepts, Three Characteristics, Brahmaviharas, Mindfulness of Breathing and the Five Hindrances, each with practice cards

GROW YOUR PRACTICE
• Streaks, weekly stats and a calendar of blooming days
• Unlock new worlds for Padma: Forest monastery, Full-moon night, Mountain temple and Bodhi at sunset
• Daily reminders for your morning sit and evening study

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no subscriptions and no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Sati supports wellbeing but is not a substitute for professional care. If you are struggling in Australia, call Lifeline on 13 11 14.

review_notes:
Sati is a free meditation and study app from the Buddhist Society of Australia (ACNC-registered charity). No login is required and there are no in-app purchases.

How to review:
1. Complete or skip the short intro.
2. Sit tab (centre): choose a duration and Begin. The bell sounds and a zen-garden timer runs. Ending a session of 1 minute or more logs it.
3. Settings (gear on Home) > Apple Health > Log Mindful Minutes asks for HealthKit write permission. Completed meditations are saved as Mindful Minutes. The app never reads Health data.
4. Settings > Daily reminders schedules two local notifications.
5. Guard tab: presets and the 'Set up a doorway' card. The doorway URL sati://pause/instagram opens the mindful-pause screen; users add it with Shortcuts' Open URLs action. 'Try it' previews it in-app.
6. Home > Screen time tiles let users enter numbers from Settings > Screen Time.

All data is stored on device. Content (lessons) is bundled and works offline.
